entries.rationale: Pinned ^0.5.1 resolves to 0.5.3; its claim handed out a warm pool entry whose directory was deleted outside the pool, running git with a missing cwd -> 'spawnSync git ENOENT' (hit during imboard #4164 setup, reproduced on 0.5.3 and 0.7.1). Fixed in worktree-pool 0.7.2 (ai-dossier#767); a 0.x caret range never leaves its minor, so the pin must move explicitly.

entries.anchor: Pool claim fails with `spawnSync git ENOENT`
entries.rationale: Troubleshooting row for the claim ENOENT failure mode so a future run recognises it instead of debugging PATH; see ai-dossier#767.

Option 2 renamed the worktree folder then ran a pathless git worktree repair, which leaves the admin gitdir naming the old folder; probed: the next git worktree prune deletes the admin dir and the repurposed checkout is corrupted (ai-dossier#443/#1232). Repair by the new path.
